acting_director_badge.name: ACTING DIRECTOR OF VEGETATION CREDENTIAL
acting_director_badge.description: An emergency appointment card naming you ACTING DIRECTOR OF VEGETATION. Its issuing office is a gardening machine. That makes it no less valid.

certified_seed_canister.name: CERTIFIED BOTANICAL SEED CANISTER
certified_seed_canister.description: A dull metal cylinder with a sealed packet of viable seeds from Botanical Specimen 001. KEEP SEALED. DESTINATION: OUTSIDE APPROVED GROWING AREA.

description.text: A chunky glass-vial botanical exposure injector from the first-aid box. The printed handling label is folded beneath a metal clip.

The injector is labelled EXPERIMENTAL BOTANICAL EXPOSURE ANTIDOTE. EXPIRED 1977. Its age means the dose may not work. A successful dose fully cures spore and thorn infections; a failed dose changes nothing.
